content.value_statement: Belgian tender documents can make eligibility checks and bidding priorities difficult to assess. This guide structures eligibility requirements, weighted award criteria, and a preliminary bidding recommendation.
actual_capabilities: Guide extraction of exclusion grounds, selection requirements, and mandatory eligibility conditions from supplied tender documents.
Organize award criteria and their percentage weights for bid planning.
Structure a preliminary go or no-go assessment for the procurement file.
Guide comparison of estimated contract value with applicable procurement thresholds and procedures.
Prepare a working assessment for review by a legal adviser or procurement specialist.
limitations: Covers Belgian public procurement in classical sectors, not foreign tenders or special sectors such as water and energy.
Produces working documents, not legal advice or an authoritative eligibility decision.
Claims updated 2026-2027 thresholds but includes no threshold table, official citations, or automatic update mechanism.
Contains only a public guide; original package scripts, extension source, and templates are not included.

use_cases.title: Screen a potential bid
use_cases.description: Compare tender eligibility requirements with company evidence before committing proposal resources.

use_cases.title: Prioritize proposal effort
use_cases.description: Organize weighted award criteria and identify where the proposal needs stronger supporting evidence.

use_cases.title: Prepare a review dossier
use_cases.description: Collect eligibility gaps, procedure questions, and unresolved threshold checks for professional review.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize eligibility
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Belgian tender: [text]. List mandatory eligibility conditions, exclusion grounds, and missing information. Do not assume company compliance.

prompt_templates.title: Map award criteria
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract award criteria and weights from [tender text]. Identify proposal priorities and cite supporting sections. Mark missing weights as unknown.

prompt_templates.title: Assess bidding readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [tender requirements] with [company evidence]. Give a provisional go or no-go recommendation, evidence gaps, and questions for legal review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: evaluate readiness using company evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Review procedure and thresholds
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [tender] using [contract value], [contract type], and [dated official threshold source]. Assess eligibility, procedure, award weights, and uncertainties. Separate evidence from assumptions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine procurement checks in a review dossier.

output_examples.input: Illustrative tender: three references required; price 50%, approach 30%, sustainability 20%. Company evidence confirms only two references.
output: Recommendation: Do not proceed until the reference requirement is resolved.
Eligibility gap: Three references are required; only two are documented.
Next action: Confirm whether another qualifying reference can be supplied.

output_examples.input: Review a Belgian office furnishing tender with no contract estimate or official threshold source supplied.
output: Threshold assessment: Undetermined because the contract estimate and current official threshold source are missing.
Procedure assessment: Requires the contract classification and applicable threshold.
Recommendation: Obtain the missing information before finalizing the bidding decision.

best_practices: Provide complete tender documents and verified company evidence; identify missing attachments before assessing eligibility.
Verify thresholds against dated official sources for the contract type and relevant procurement period.
Have a qualified reviewer confirm eligibility, procedural conclusions, and unresolved legal questions before submission.
anti_patterns: Treating the preliminary recommendation as legal advice or an official eligibility ruling.
Assuming the guide contains a verified current threshold database or automatic procurement portal integration.
Declaring compliance without evidence for every mandatory requirement.

faq.question: Which procurement rules does the guide cover?
faq.answer: It references Belgian classical-sector procurement under the law of 17 June 2016 and the royal decree of 18 April 2017.

faq.question: Does it support foreign tenders or special sectors?
faq.answer: No. The guide excludes foreign tenders and special sectors such as water and energy.

faq.question: Are the procurement thresholds verified?
faq.answer: The guide claims 2026-2027 coverage but supplies no threshold table or citations. Verify applicable amounts using current official sources.

faq.question: Can it make the final participation decision?
faq.answer: No. It provides a working assessment, not legal advice. The contracting authority retains the final assessment.

faq.question: Does this package include scripts or form templates?
faq.answer: No. This folder contains only the public guide, without the original scripts, extension source, or templates.

faq.question: Does it automatically complete or submit UEA or ESPD forms?
faq.answer: The description mentions form assistance, but the guide provides no completion workflow, form templates, or submission integration.
